question.prompt: In \(\odot O\), \(\angle AOB=100^\circ\), and point \(C\) lies on minor arc \(AB\). Find the measure of \(\angle ACB\) (unit: degrees).

solutions.explanation: Point \(C\) lies on the minor arc, so \(\angle ACB\) intercepts the major arc, whose measure is \(360^\circ-100^\circ=260^\circ\). Therefore, \(\angle ACB=260^\circ\div2=130^\circ\).
solutions.title: Identify the intercepted major arc
